title.narrative: Chiles Integrity and Transparency Agenda Support Program II
PROGRAMA DE APOYO A LA AGENDA DE PROBIDAD Y TRANSPARENCIA DE CHILE II

description.narrative: El objetivo general es apoyar la Agenda de Probidad y Transparencia de Chile, que considera un conjunto de medidas de poltica dirigidas a contribuir a la observancia de la probidad y transparencia en el funcionamiento del sector pblico y el sector privado, y promover conductas afines entre la ciudadana. La presente operacin es la segunda de dos consecutivas, vinculadas tcnicamente entre s, pero financiadas de forma independiente bajo la modalidad de Prstamo Programtico en Apoyo de Reformas de Poltica

The main objective of this program is to support Chile's Integrity and Transparency Agenda, which calls for a series of policy measures to contribute to integrity and transparency in the operation of the public and private sectors and to promote similar conduct among the citizenry. This is the second of two consecutive operations that are technically linked but separately financed as programmatic policy-based loans.
Commitment in 2016-09-21
Disbursement in third quarter of 2017
